usedFor: TimeRex holds booked events, and Freshsales Classic receives each as a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A booking creates a deal linked to an account, and the contact too if missing.

watchOut: “Event Cancelled” in TimeRex only reaches the right deal through “Update Deal” if you pass its ID or name.
